phase_impact.rationale: Keep ABVX transitive authority and conservative invalidation; copy explicit hashes/params and cycle checks.
Keep own manifest; fingerprint excludes run timestamp/output path, attempt evidence distinct.
Delegate generation; no new renderer adoption required for existing TeX.

phase_impact.item: P2 visible Contents / nav / destination parity
phase_impact.rationale: Reuse audit_print_toc_parity; normalize inventories; standards checker does not replace trio.
Use AST and standards diagnostics; ABVX verifies expected chapter order/coverage.
Existing Pandoc first; thin canonical-input/metadata/asset wrapper; no handwritten ZIP/OPF/nav engine.
External authoritative checker, versioned raw JSON and hash-bound result.
Parse EARL assertions/manual checklist; preserve manual gate.
Keep current ReportLab/TeX/LibreOffice adapters; renderer bakeoff only if new-title gap proven.
Reuse current qpdf/Poppler; complete transformed bbox extraction remains custom adapter duty.
Keep ABVX retailer policy, coordinate transforms and final placement effective DPI.
Only when a target requires PDF/UA; do not impose PDF/A on all retail print.
Schema/checksum libraries for mechanics; credits/rights/ISBN assignment stay custom.
No ONIX feed requirement demonstrated for D2D handoff; test only on actual feed need.
Wrap bounded image primitives; retain rights/owner art lock, spine geometry and visual gate.
No donor replaces historical state/series/Pictiq authority; do not start creative work.
TMX interchange adapter with stable ABVX unit IDs; outputs suggestions until accepted.
Cache includes source, adjacent/global context, Bible, model/prompt/config and QA versions.
Existing bounded runner/broker boundary; CAT does not reserve provider spend.

phase_impact.item: P5 TP/sitelen semantic and glyph alignment
phase_impact.rationale: Native semantic/knowledge/name/continuation and font/render equivalence remain module-specific.
Build/upload/preview/live evidence stay distinct; no automatic writes.
Versioned owned CSV staging, units/currency provenance, idempotent import; unknown stays null.
Promote lessons only into real validators/tests; external fixtures supplement local escaped defects.
Not a named original phase; bounded read-only edition comparison, no actual Machine Mind update.
Claim/source/time evidence envelope; human determines meaning/currentness. Not autonomous fact checking.
Prevent scope addition; original plan already excludes this, so no planned feature is actually removed.

limitations: Exact release dates/commit freshness missing except onixcheck; null is unknown, not no maintenance.
No runtime, install, SBOM, telemetry or network-isolation audit; no donor admission.
Per-file fixture/theme/font rights must be resolved before reuse.
Current design docs still say READY FOR REVIEW; user describes approved architecture. No approval/state/history mutation performed.
